violated_contract: An automated surface that only needs a generated result must not reuse the user-facing endpoint that also owns the user's durable state. The Windows AI Clone drafted replies through POST /v2/messages, which persists the drafting prompt as a human chat row, counts it against chat quota, runs goal extraction on it, and persists the generated answer — so machine activity wrote turns into the human's canonical chat history and could create goals from text the user never sent.
canonical_prevention: Give the automated surface its own owner-authenticated endpoint that reuses the same generation path with persistence and session identity removed (no session acquired or mutated, no message written, no quota question attributed), and prove it with a behavioral test that drives the real handler and asserts no chat-state write occurs.
